note:
If hr exists, FR metrics (lpips,dists) are computed. NR metrics (niqe,maniqa,musiq) are always computed on res. CLIP-IQA is excluded because it is not implemented in local_iqa. For FR alignment, hr is transformed to res size with diffusers resize_mode='crop' center-crop semantics when fr_resize=to_res_crop (legacy alias: to_ref).
Restoration metrics are computed on Y channel with crop_border=scale. If shape mismatches, hr is aligned to res using diffusers resize_mode='crop' center-crop semantics.
